problem: a,b,c,d = construct_isquare(), e = construct_on_line(d,a), f = construct_on_circum(a,b,d)
proof:
Solution:
1. Square(a,b,c,d) => Angle_a_d_c - Angle_b_a_d & Angle_a_b_d - Angle_a_c_d
2. Collinear(a,d,e) => Angle_b_a_d - Angle_b_a_e
3. Angle_a_d_c - Angle_b_a_d & Angle_b_a_d - Angle_b_a_e => Angle_a_d_c - Angle_b_a_e
4. Concyclic(a,b,d,f) => Angle_a_b_d + Angle_a_f_d - pi
5. Angle_a_b_d + Angle_a_f_d - pi & Angle_a_b_d - Angle_a_c_d => Angle_a_c_d + Angle_a_f_d - pi
6. Angle_a_c_d + Angle_a_f_d - pi => Concyclic(a,c,d,f)
7. Concyclic(a,c,d,f) => Angle_a_d_c - Angle_a_f_c
8. Angle_a_d_c - Angle_b_a_e & Angle_a_d_c - Angle_a_f_c => Angle_a_f_c - Angle_b_a_e
